required_patches.description: Pass the resolved lld path as argv[0] instead of the literal "ld.lld", so MLIR's ROCDL target finds the linker when it is not on PATH under that name.
Allow overriding xnack=any codegen to xnack- or xnack+ on gfx1250 via LLVM_GFX1250_ANY_XNACK_CODEGEN env var.

On pin 1cc8189160 the gfx1250-strict target, its ISA sets, the VOPD3 FP64 hazard, WMMA gating, the gfx1250 XNACK on/off modes and the xcnt/REPLAY_MODE codegen are already upstream. This patch keeps only what the pin still lacks: gate the block16 cvt-scale intrinsics, instruction defs and clang builtins behind block16-cvt-scale-insts so gfx1250-strict disables them; and teach MLIR Chipset::parse to ignore processor suffixes such as -strict so convert-gpu-to-rocdl accepts gfx1250-strict.

required_patches.description: Add sched.bank / sched.vgpr / sched.sgpr / sched.agpr hints on pin 1cc8189160. A strict sched.agpr pin stays on the AGPR file: the pseudo is kept through coalescing so the class is not widened to AV_*, and allocation hints admit only that file. Strict sched.vgpr / sched.sgpr pins also keep their pseudo until expandPostRAPseudo, so coalescing cannot drop the exact-register hint and every later use of the pinned value reads the requested register. By default (-amdgpu-strict-pin-tie-src-dst) a strict pin ties its source to its result before register allocation, so the allocator assigns one physical register and expandPostRAPseudo does not emit a copy; passing -amdgpu-strict-pin-tie-src-dst=0 leaves the pseudo untied. regnum -1 (an omitted regnum on the ROCDL ops) pins only the register file, and a soft one has no effect. Strict regnum -1 AGPR pins get one AGPR index per accumulator chain (joined through the pin, the MFMA accumulator input, PHIs and COPYs) when all chains fit, so accumulators stay in place as with explicit indices; otherwise, and for VGPR/SGPR, the hint admits any register of the file and prefers the registers already given to the pin's source and result and the MFMA accumulator input. A strict pin covers the whole variable it starts: AMDGPUCodeGenPrepare gives the same pin to every value that replaces it through a PHI or as an MFMA accumulator (unless the pins of that variable disagree), and the coalescer keeps the pin's hint when it merges the variable's registers, so a value pinned once before a loop keeps one register across iterations. SILowerSGPRSpills keeps the WWM pool for SGPR spill lanes off VGPRs named by strict pins, falling back to them only when unpinned VGPRs run out, and builds the per-lane VGPR mask from every VGPR outside the pool so wwm-regalloc cannot assign v256 and above outside it. Retargeted from the patch written against 1df311a6: keep the functional changes and drop the clang-format-only churn that does not apply here.
